name: youtube-agent
description: AI YouTube Agent - automated content creation & publishing

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:dashboard" "npm run dev:agent" "npm run dev:bot"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../dashboard && npm install && cd ../agent && npm install && cd ../bot && npm install
scripts.db:migrate: cd server && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:seed: cd server && npx prisma db seed
